operations.details: Verified official Open Geospatial Consortium Features and Geometries JSON (JSON-FG) page.
Feature encoding separated from coordinate accuracy.
Expanded CRS/geometry capability not promoted to survey precision.
Authoritative geometry and terrain lineage remain required.
Verified official Open Geospatial Consortium KML page.
Earth-browser visualization separated from terrain observation.
Map annotations not promoted to surveyed coordinates or height.
Measurement source and error budget remain required.
Both OGC JSON-FG and OGC KML URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No service/model/encoding value substituted for parcel terrain measurement without independent lineage.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
